name: Cynthia Ng Monje
office: City of Arcadia, Member of the City Council, 3rd District

items.text: Cynthia Ng Monje is a lab coordinator and administrator. She is a retired senior executive administrator at the Jet Propulsion Laboratory.

sentences.text: Cynthia Ng Monje is a lab coordinator and administrator.
She is a retired senior executive administrator at the Jet Propulsion Laboratory.

items.text: In a San Gabriel Valley Tribune questionnaire, she said she aims to restore trust in District 3 through transparency and accountability after the former mayor's indictment. She supports responsible housing growth and wants more public involvement at city council meetings. Her campaign website says she backs neighborhood safety, local businesses and green open spaces.
